source_identity_note: Source commit identifies the site lane before integration; cherry-picks may change commit identity. Tree and file hashes identify captured content.
method: Fresh actual Chromium screenshots of the final Install KB prompt with immutable GitHub raw URL and targeted word wrapping, produced by the passing 24-test Playwright suite and visually reviewed. limitations: Public website only; screenshots do not establish native agent activation.
